name: Grade 7 IIT Summative: Poster and Media Design
description: Ten core second-trimester words for the Grade 7 poster and media design vocabulary table.

words.definition: The people who will see or use something.
words.example: The poster audience was Grade 6 students learning about e-waste.
The purpose of the poster was to convince students to recycle batteries safely.

words.definition: A visual message with text and images.
words.example: The student created a poster with one clear title, image, and call to action.

words.definition: An online tool for making designs.
words.example: The group used Canva to arrange the poster text, image, and logo.

words.definition: A clear difference that helps things stand out.
words.example: The student improved contrast by placing dark text on a light background.

words.definition: How text and objects line up.
words.example: The designer used alignment so the title, image, and text lined up neatly.

words.definition: How easy text is to read.
words.example: The poster had good readability because the font was large and clear.

words.definition: Allowed to use without breaking copyright rules.
words.example: The student chose a copyright-free image for the environmental poster.

words.definition: A license that explains how work may be used.
words.example: The group used a Creative Commons image and checked the license rules.

words.definition: A note that says who made or provided something.
words.example: The image credit was placed at the bottom of the poster.
